# Atlas source ledger

Source paths are repository-relative. Every state and transition is listed. A feature/model witness grounds its intended behavior; `codeCandidates` identify likely files and are not a claim that every branch agrees. Confidence stays assumed until code, Quint and Gherkin agree on the visible projection. Existing docs and conformance/DMN/glossary contracts were inventoried; no PRD, Figma file, help center or support macro was supplied. No external product source was invented.

| Authority | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| README.md | Product name, users, stack and integrations |
| specs/README.md context map | Boundaries, directions and published contracts |
| specs/conformance.yaml + glossaries/DMN/Alloy/OpenSLO | Capabilities, data constraints, vocabulary and quality obligations; not independently turned into duplicate lifecycle rules |
| 231 .feature files | All 1,520 declarations; 1,636 concrete parsed examples |
| 72 .qnt files | 42 context-local mutable models and two whole-product interpretations projected; declarations/helpers/composition explicitly disposed |
| Application source | Literal routes, named screens/modal/sheets, status/config/time candidates; direct primary-flow evidence and incomplete review leads |
